name: Steam runtime (fetched from Valve by the console)
notes: The three Valve DLLs the Steam engine needs. Our repository publishes only their hashes; the console fetches the bytes from Valve's own client-update CDN. Pinned to SteamCMD's steamcmd_bins_win32 package of 2026-01-30 (steamclient 10.41.26.25): the build every RVA in gh_steam_engine.h / GREENHOUSE.md 25.5 and 26.10 was reverse-engineered on. A different build is refused, not installed.

patches.why: the slim Xbox user32 has no MapVirtualKeyExA, so the OS loader refuses the DLL; the same import-name rename as UnityPlayer.dll (GREENHOUSE.md 19), byte-identical to the copy every Steam test so far ran
